senses.gloss:
mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं)
1 Angry, wrathful.
2 Hot, sharp, pungent, acrid.
3 Formidable, terrible.
4 Cruel, fierce, savage.
m. (-ग्रः)
1 A name of ŚIVA.
2 A name of a mixed tribe, from a Kṣatriya father and Śūdra mother: the employment of this caste, according to MANU, is the killing or catching of animals that live in holes, as a snake-catcher, &c.; according to the Tantras, the Ugra is an encomiast or bard.
3 A tree, (Morunga hyperanthera, &c.)
4 A class of asterisms, Maghā, Bharaṇi, Pūrvaphalgunī, Pūrvāṣāḍhā, Pūrvabhadrapada.
5 A name of Malabar.
f. (-ग्रा)
1 Orris root.
2 A medicinal plant.
3 An Ugra woman.
n. (-ग्रं)
Wrath, anger.
E.
उच to accumulate, रन् Uṇādi affix, च is changed to ग.

mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म)
Fierce, violent, cruel.
E.
उग्र and कर्म्मन् act.

m. (-ण्डः)
A sort of gourd, (Momordica charantia.)
E.
उग्र and काण्ड a stem.

mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं)
Strong smelling.
m. (-न्धः)
1 A plant, (Michelia champaca.)
2 Garlic.
n. (-न्धं)
Asafoetida.
f. (-न्धा)
1 Common carraway, (Carum carui, &c.) see अजमोदा.
2 Orris root.
3 A medicinal plant.
E.
उग्र violent, &c. and गन्ध scent.

mfn. (-न्धी-न्धिनी-न्धि)
Strong smelling.
E.
उग्रगन्ध and इनि aff.

m. (-यः)
Desire.
E.
उग्र fierce, चय a heap.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Violence, passionateness.
2 Pungency, acrimony.
E.
उग्र angry, and त्व; also with तल् affix. उग्रता f. (-ता.)

mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं)
Relentless, remorseless.
E.
उग्र and दण्ड punishment.

m. (-न्वा)
A name of INDRA.
E.
उग्र fierce, and धन्वन् a bowyer.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Large-nosed.
E.
उग्र formidable, and नासिका a nose.

mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं)
1 Frightful, hideous, fierce looking.
2 Malignant, wicked.
E.
उग्र fierce, पश्य looking.

f. (-रा)
A name of GAṄGĀ.
E.
उग्र ŚIVA, and शेखरा a crest.

m. (-नः)
1 The name of a prince, the father of DEVAKĪ and KAṂSA, and king of Mathurā.
2 The name of another prince, the son of PARIKṢIT.
E.
उग्र fierce, and सेना an army.

m. (-जः)
A name of KAṂSA, the uncle and enemy of KṚṢṆA.
E.
उग्रसेन and ज born; also उग्रमेनतनयः, उग्रसेनपुत्रः, उग्रसेनसुतः, &c.
